question: How many days of annual leave do I get?
answer: You get 14 working days of paid annual leave per year [1].

sources.text:
Kabut Labs Employee Handbook, version 3.1
3
Annual leave
Everyone gets 14 working days of paid annual leave per year. Leave builds up monthly, so you
earn about 1.17 days for each month worked. New starters can use leave once they have earned it,
including during probation.
Request leave in Lumbung. For anything longer than two days, ask at least seven days ahead so
the team can plan. Up to five unused days carry over into the next year; carried-over days expire on
31 March.
Sick leave
Tell your lead as early as you can on the day. Sick leave is paid. For absences longer than two
consecutive working days we need a doctor's note, uploaded to Lumbung when you are back.
Parental and other leave
Maternity leave is three months, following Indonesian law. Fathers get ten working days of paid
paternity leave, to be taken within 60 days of the birth or adoption. Bereavement leave is three
working days for a close family member. Public holidays follow the government calendar.

Probation
New employees have a three-month probation period. Halfway through, you and your lead have a
check-in to talk about how it is going. At the end, your lead confirms your contract in writing.
Performance and growth
Everyone has a one-to-one with their lead every two weeks. Formal reviews happen twice a year, in
June and December, and salary changes are decided after the December review.
Leaving Kabut Labs
The notice period is 30 days after probation and seven days during probation. Your last salary,
unused annual leave and any approved expense claims are paid with the next regular payroll.

Kabut Labs Employee Handbook, version 3.1

Working hours
A full-time week is 40 hours, Monday to Friday. Core hours are 10:00 to 15:00 WIB. During core
hours you should be reachable on team chat and available for meetings. Outside core hours you
choose when to start and finish, as long as you start between 07:00 and 10:00.
Overtime is not expected. If a release or an incident means you work more than 45 hours in a week,
record it in Lumbung (our HR app) and take the time back within the next month.
Remote work
After probation you may work remotely up to three days a week. Agree the days with your lead and
keep them in the team calendar. Firmware and hardware roles may need to be in the lab more often
during prototype builds.
Working from outside Indonesia needs written approval from the Head of People at least 14 days
before you travel, and is limited to 30 days per calendar year. You are responsible for a stable
connection during core hours.

Kabut Labs Employee Handbook, version 3.1
4
Pay day
Salaries are paid on the 25th of each month. When the 25th falls on a weekend or public holiday,
we pay on the working day before it. Payslips are available in Lumbung on the same day.
The religious holiday allowance (THR) is one month's salary and is paid at least 14 days before Eid
al-Fitr, earlier than the legal minimum.
Benefits
We register everyone with BPJS Kesehatan and BPJS Ketenagakerjaan from the first day. On top
of that, each employee has a learning budget of Rp 6,000,000 per year for courses, books,
certifications and conference tickets. Unused budget does not roll over.
People who work remotely at least two days a week receive an internet allowance of Rp 350,000
per month with their salary.

 Kabut Labs Employee Handbook
Welcome to Kabut Labs
Kabut Labs is a small hardware and software company in Salatiga, Central Java. We design
low-power sensors for homes and small farms and the app that goes with them. There are 34 of us,
split across firmware, cloud, mobile, support and operations.
This handbook explains how we work: hours, leave, pay, equipment and the rules we hold each
other to. It applies to everyone on a permanent or fixed-term contract. Interns get a shorter version
from the People team.
If something here is unclear or out of date, tell the People team at people@kabutlabs.example. We
review the handbook every January. This is version 3.1, effective 1 February 2026.
Our office
The office is at Jl. Kemiri Raya 12, Salatiga. It is open from 07:00 to 20:00 on working days. Visitors
sign in at the front desk and must be accompanied in the lab area.
